executive_summary: Successfully completed Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the release-component graph design implementation. All OpenSpec release-management contract documents have been updated to define graph-backed component scope resolution with normative requirements. The missing spec.md artifact has been created with comprehensive requirements and scenarios. This documentation-first phase establishes the canonical contract for how the release-component graph will drive component-scoped release planning, validation, and publication.

key_changes: Added canonical release-component graph requirement with complete field definitions
Added graph-backed component scope resolution algorithm (5-step deterministic process)
Strengthened gating language from SHOULD to MUST for graph-derived affected_components
Added fail-closed behavior for unmapped release-relevant paths
Clarified transitive dependency expansion as mandatory
Created comprehensive requirements specification with 8 major requirements
Defined 30+ Given/When/Then scenarios for contract compliance
Documented conformance criteria for implementation validation
Established clear rationale for each requirement
